data.summary: Marsh McLennan Companies (MRSH) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: The consulting business faces competition from global, regional and local firms, including independent consulting, broking and outsourcing firms affiliated with accounting, technology and financial services and new entrants utilizing generative AI.

In addition, increasing use of generative AI models, including new capabilities offered through Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers, in our internal systems may create new attack methods for adversaries.
